scripts.preinstall: sh -c 'rm -f package-lock.json yarn.lock; case "$npm_config_user_agent" in pnpm/*) ;; *) echo "Use pnpm instead" >&2; exit 1 ;; esac'
scripts.build: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm -r --if-present run build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:libs && NEXUS_FM_API_CLIENT_DECLARATIONS_READY=1 pnpm -r --filter "./artifacts/**" --filter "./scripts" --if-present run typecheck
scripts.test:nexus-typecheck-declarations: pnpm --filter @workspace/api-client-react run test:nexus-typecheck-declarations && pnpm run test:workspace-typecheck-declarations
